items.title: Dick Griffin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 12, 2024
items.q: Roy Haynes, see that was my time to play with Roy Haynes you know.

ctx.x: Well when you all walked off the stage, can you remember the conversation?

Yes. Okay? Everybody was — like excited, oh wow. Roy Haynes, see that was my time to play with Roy Haynes you know. Roy Haynes to the day, it’s like a really — everything he plays is different and innovative and fresh you know. And he mentioned somebody asked him about rudiments and everything and he said, “I don’t do that because these hands are uneven” or something. He mentioned something like that. But oh, it was just — everybody was like wow — magic happened, and nothing was really rehearsed ‘cause we thought…
And Ed’s comment afterwards, I forget his exact words but it just put a whole, I don’t know it was quite humorous.
